coverage.domain: project validation and first-slice capability gate

source.check: The runner's own first-slice checks (studio/openmc_studio/headless.py, test/test_headless.py) refuse the same faults.
source.text: An eigenvalue project with 500 particles per batch (40 batches, 10 inactive). The runner refuses fewer than 1000 particles per batch for an eigenvalue run (MCNP 6.3 manual 2.8.1.4: trial runs use about 1000): too noisy to judge convergence by.
